tool: gpt-image 스킬(Codex 내장 image_gen, ChatGPT 구독 인증)
prompt:
Product reference photo of a single-leaf steel fire door of the kind fitted at the stairwell entrance on every floor of an aging 1990s Korean four-storey brick villa. The leaf is 120 cm wide, 210 cm high and about 5 cm thick, flush pressed steel with no window, painted a slightly worn warm light grey semi-gloss enamel. On the face toward the viewer: three heavy butt hinges on the left edge, a plain satin silver lever handle on a small round rose at 95 cm height near the right edge, an overhead hydraulic door closer body near the top left corner with a short black two-part arm folded along the top edge, and a black rubber sweep strip along the bottom edge. Wear: scuffed and slightly grubby around the lever and across the bottom 40 cm where shoes push it, a few small chipped spots along the edges showing darker grey primer, a faint dirty hand band at shoulder height. No stickers on the door. The door is shown alone, closed and standing upright, seen from a gentle three-quarter angle from the hinge side so the face and the hinge edge are both visible. No frame, no wall, no floor.
Scene/backdrop: a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, lighting variation, or scenery.
Constraints: do not use #00ff00 or any green reflected spill anywhere on the subject; crisp silhouette suitable for chroma removal; generous green padding around the silhouette; no part of the subject cut off by the frame edge; no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no border, no cast shadow on the green background.
Rendering discipline (critical): resolve every surface with gentle continuous gradients, never with fine dots. Absolutely no per-pixel noise of any kind: no stippling, no dithering, no halftone or screen-door pattern, no pointillist speckle, no sand or dust overlay, no crosshatch, no chromatic speckle, no oversharpened edge halos, no JPEG mosquito artifacts, no added film grain. Prefer slightly soft over crunchy; if uncertain, make it smoother. Restrained detail that still reads at 512 px. Soft neutral light on the subject only, no rim light, no bloom, no colour grading, no depth of field, no motion blur, no baked contact shadow.
usage: 2·3·4층 계단실 방화문의 형상과 도장색 기준. SM_StairFireDoorLeaf와 도어클로저 팔(SM_FireDoorCloserArm, SM_FireDoorCloserRod)을 이 그림을 보고 Blender에서 만들었다.
notes: 배경이 투명하게(RGBA) 왔다. 형상 기준으로만 쓰므로 다시 뽑지 않았다.
